subject: pharmacology
title: Anastrozole, Progestogens, Ulipristal, HRT and Anabolic Steroids Integrated

steps.tx: **Anastrozole**, the reference non steroidal aromatase inhibitor, collapses postmenopausal oestrogen synthesis reversibly and became adjuvant breast cancer's standard over tamoxifen with fewer thrombotic and endometrial events, paid for in arthralgia (a leading discontinuation cause), bone density loss needing densitometry and protection, and lipid neutrality debates. Exemestane, its steroidal irreversible cousin, offers a switch after intolerance with androgenic metabolite accents.
steps.say: Anastrozole trades tamoxifen's clots and uterus for joints and bone; monitor both ledgers by name.

left.title: Anastrozole gains over tamoxifen
points: Disease free survival advantage in adjuvant trials

steps.tx: **Medroxyprogesterone** acetate is the progestogen workhorse across gynecology: injectable contraception (next lesson), endometrial protection in hormone therapy's older regimens, endometriosis and dysfunctional bleeding control, and oncology history. Its glucocorticoid and androgenic accents explain weight and mood effects and the bone density warning on long injectable use, while micronised progesterone's cleaner profile (sedation via neurosteroid metabolites included) wins modern HRT prescriptions where available.
steps.say: Medroxyprogesterone does everything adequately and some things roughly; micronised progesterone is the gentler heir.

left.title: Medroxyprogesterone profile
points: Bone density warning with long injectable use
Delayed fertility return after last injection

right.title: Micronised progesterone
points: Body identical progestogen, oral or vaginal
Breast risk cohorts kinder than synthetic progestins
First trimester support niches in protocols

steps.tx: **Ulipristal** acetate, a selective progesterone receptor modulator (SPRM), delays ovulation by postponing the LH surge even after it begins, making it the most effective oral emergency contraceptive up to 120 hours (next lesson), and at daily low dose shrank uterine fibroids in preoperative programmes until rare severe liver injury fenced it behind restrictions. Its tissue selectivity (agonist and antagonist by site) defines the SPRM class mifepristone also inhabits at the antagonist pole.
steps.say: Ulipristal postpones an LH surge already rising; its fibroid career was fenced by the liver.

nodes.label: Ulipristal 30 mg within 120 hours of intercourse
LH surge postponed even after onset

steps.tx: **The SERM concept generalises** beyond oestrogen: selective modulation means one ligand stabilising receptor conformations that recruit co activators in some tissues and co repressors in others, which is why tamoxifen, raloxifene and bazedoxifene (paired with conjugated oestrogens in a tissue selective complex) share a surname and different bodies. Examinations test the concept by asking which tissue effect follows which drug; memorising the grid outperforms memorising paragraphs.
steps.say: One receptor, tissue specific partners; the grid of agonist and antagonist cells is the examinable object.

left.title: Tissue grid essentials
points: Tamoxifen: breast antagonist, uterus and bone agonist
Raloxifene: breast and uterus antagonist, bone agonist
Bazedoxifene: paired with oestrogen for menopause
All retain venous thrombosis as a class tax

right.title: Applying the grid
points: Hot flushes worsen on raloxifene, variable on others

steps.tx: **Hormone replacement therapy** composition is the applied sum of this module: oestrogen for symptoms (transdermal estradiol preferred with risk factors), progestogen for endometrial protection where a uterus persists (micronised progesterone or medroxyprogesterone, or a levonorgestrel intrauterine system as the elegant local answer), testosterone niches for desire, and tibolone's tissue selective hybrid in some formularies. Duration is the shortest that serves the indication with annual reviews, not a lifetime sentence in either direction.
steps.say: Oestrogen for symptoms, progestogen for the uterus, route by thrombosis, duration by annual review.

left.title: Composition choices
points: Transdermal estradiol with migraine or VTE factors
Levonorgestrel intrauterine system as local protection

steps.tx: **Anabolic steroids** in medicine shrink to narrow legitimate rooms (hypogonadism covered previously, wasting in defined illnesses historically, hereditary angioedema's danazol cousin, aplastic anaemia antiques) while their misuse economy borrows the whole class. The pharmacology distinction examinations want is anabolic versus androgenic ratio mythology: all anabolic steroids are androgenic at the receptor, separation is partial at best, and virilisation in women and children follows any of them given enough dose and time.
steps.say: No purely anabolic steroid exists; the ratio is marketing, the receptor is honest.

right.title: Universal androgenic truths
points: Virilisation dose and time dependent in women
Separation of anabolic from androgenic is partial only

steps.tx: **Progestogen only therapeutics beyond** contraception deserve their line: norethisterone delays menstruation and treats dysfunctional bleeding with thrombosis counsel, high dose progestogens palliate endometrial and breast cancers historically, and progesterone support inhabits assisted reproduction and threatened miscarriage protocols with evidence graded indication by indication. Each use is endometrial biology applied: proliferation restrained, secretion organised, withdrawal scheduled.
steps.say: Progestogens organise the endometrium on prescription: delay it, protect it, or prepare it, by dose and day.

nodes.label: Progestogen prescribed with a named indication
Bleeding controlled, protection or support achieved
Thrombosis, mood and metabolic review by agent

steps.tx: **Close the sex hormone** module by sorting its grid: gonadal steroids (testosterone, estradiol, progesterone forms), their receptor modulators (SERMs, SPRMs, antiandrogens), synthesis blockers (aromatase, 5 alpha reductase, GnRH upstream), and pituitary drivers from the previous module. Vignettes give a tissue and a desired direction; the grid returns the drug family before brand memory wakes, which is the intended use of everything in the last three lessons.
steps.say: Tissue plus direction returns the family; let the grid answer before the brand names argue.

left.title: Grid by lever
points: Block synthesis: aromatase, 5 alpha reductase, GnRH

right.title: Grid by fence
points: Teratogenic fences: antiandrogens, danazol, reductase blockers
Fertility fences: exogenous testosterone, GnRH analogues
